$comment: THE PACK MAP — which pack exists, which packs it stands on (`requires`),
and what it is called in a listing. Each pack's `pwpack.json` is generated
from this file (node tools/apply-pack-map.mjs).
NAMES. Pack ids carry no vendor prefix; `foundation` is the floor every
other pack stands on (`floor`).
PLACEMENT. An atom lives in the pack whose VOCABULARY it belongs to. The
floor carries the block vocabulary every app needs, the shells, the page
furniture, the form family, the themes, the icons and the engines; widgets
carries the occasional blocks, kept off the floor so an app that never
places them never lists them.
REQUIRES IS EXPLICIT. Every pack lists its `requires`, the floor included
(an empty list). In `pwpack.json` each entry becomes `{ id, range }`, the
range being the peer's current major. A pack's closure is the transitive set
of its `requires`; the integrity check's `--resolve-against` roots and the
tsconfig `rootDirs` are derived from it.
INVARIANT RULES (gate: tools/check-pack-map.mjs):
(a) every pattern's `usesBlocks` is a subset of its own pack's blocks plus
the blocks of its `requires` closure;
(c) block, pattern and surface counts match `expect` exactly, and the
catalogue total matches `expectTotal` (so a map edited to hide a lost
atom is still caught);
(d) every pack stays under `atomCap` atoms;
(e) no manifest (usesBlocks, composesWith, a `category.name` reference in
knowledge text, surface blocks, patternsExercised) names an atom
outside its closure.
A pack may name the packs below it, never the ones above: widgets may name
foundation, foundation may not name widgets.
EVERY BLOCK IS SEEN. A block counts as shown when a pattern or surface of
its own pack, or of a pack that stands on it, places it, or when a DOM test
of its own pack renders it (check-integrity). A block nothing renders fails.
SOURCE ACROSS PACK BOUNDARIES. A published pack's archive carries only its
own files, so a relative import into a neighbour pack does not resolve. The
few shared helpers a pack's blocks need are GENERATED into the pack, never
copied by hand: `vendors` names floor files the pack gets a copy of, and
`kit` names single symbols from the floor's shared utilities collected into
the pack's `atoms/lib/_kit.ts`. check-integrity verifies each copy matches
its source. A block must resolve inside its own pack: each block atom is
bundled on its own.

rules.closure: A pattern's usesBlocks is a subset of its own pack's blocks plus the blocks of its requires closure.
rules.noGhosts: No manifest names an atom outside its requires closure: usesBlocks, composesWith, dotted block ids in knowledge text, surface blocks, patternsExercised.
rules.counts: Each pack carries exactly expect.blocks blocks and expect.patterns patterns (and expect.surfaces surfaces where declared).
rules.atomCap: Every pack stays under atomCap atoms (blocks + patterns + surfaces + capabilities + themes + icon set + connectors + providers + identity methods — what the canonical builder counts).

listing.name: Foundation
listing.description: The ground floor every app stands on: the core block vocabulary (layout, text, controls, forms, data, feedback, media), the top-bar, bottom-bar and chrome-less shells with their page parts, six themes, each with its own dark mode (zinc, midnight, paper, linen, slate, ember), the icon dictionary, four capabilities and the REST connector.

listing.name: Widgets
listing.description: The occasional blocks, kept out of the floor so an app that never places them never lists them: rich-text editor, file dropzone, tag input, combobox, slider, chart, month calendar, rating, map, carousel, video, embed, gallery, world clock, tree view, command palette and like button.
